# Cam nang du lich Ha Long

Ha Long is associated with limestone islands, bay cruises, seafood, caves, beaches, and short trips from Hanoi. A practical guide should cover cruise booking, weather cancellation risk, port locations, overnight and day-trip options, family activities, and responsible waste behavior on the bay. Travelers should compare routes and safety standards before booking.
